## Role in the pipeline

| | |
|---|---|
| **Thesis section** | 3.1 Alliance data |
| **Next file** | `02_firm_data.qmd` |

The SDC extract contains one row per alliance, with the two participants
stored as concatenated text (separated by `;`). This file (1) reads and
stacks the exports, (2) keeps completed two-partner alliances, and
(3) splits every alliance into one row per participant, so that each firm
can later be treated as a focal firm. Each alliance is also classified as
equity-based or non-equity (section 1b). In the later files the column `jv`
holds this equity-based indicator (the name is kept so that files 3 to 6 run unchanged).

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("00_config.R")
library(readxl)
```

## 1. Read and stack the SDC files

Sheet 1 only (sheet 2 contains documentation). Everything is read as text,
so SIC codes keep their leading zeros.

```{r}
#| label: read
files_sdc <- list.files(path, pattern = "^SDC.*\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
files_sdc <- files_sdc[!grepl("Technique", basename(files_sdc))]   # technique files are read in 1b
basename(files_sdc)

read_sdc <- function(f) {
  d <- read_excel(f, sheet = 1, skip = 2, col_types = "text", .name_repair = "minimal")
  names(d) <- make.unique(names(d))
  setDT(d)
}
sdc <- rbindlist(lapply(files_sdc, read_sdc), use.names = TRUE)
dim(sdc)   # 240,565 rows, 44 columns

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sdc$`Joint Venture/Alliance SDC Deal Number`))

excel_date <- function(x) as.Date(as.numeric(x), origin = "1899-12-30")
sdc[, date := excel_date(`Date Announced`)]
sdc[, year := year(date)]
```

## 1b. Equity-based vs. non-equity alliances

The SDC Joint Venture Flag only marks alliances in which a new legal entity
was created. Other equity arrangements are recorded in the field *Alliance
Technique* (codes ET = Equity Transfer, CET = Cross Equity Transfer). Following
LSEG support (personal communication, 2026), an alliance is classified as
**equity-based** if the Joint Venture Flag is true or the technique contains
ET or CET. All other alliances are **non-equity**. The definition is set in
`00_config.R` (`equity_definition`); `"jv_only"` gives the robustness version.

The technique field is exported separately (same deals, four date blocks)
and joined by deal number.

```{r}
#| label: technique
files_tech <- list.files(path, pattern = "^SDC_Technique.*\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
basename(files_tech)

read_tech <- function(f) {
  d <- read_excel(f, sheet = 1, skip = 2, col_types = "text", .name_repair = "minimal")
  setDT(d)
  d[, .(deal      = `Joint Venture/Alliance SDC Deal Number`,
        technique = `Alliance Technique (Code)`)]
}
tech <- rbindlist(lapply(files_tech, read_tech))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tech$deal))

# TRUE if any of the (semicolon-separated) technique codes is in `codes`
has_code <- function(x, codes) {
  vapply(strsplit(x, ";", fixed = TRUE),
         function(z) any(trimws(z) %in% codes), logical(1))
}

sdc[tech, on = c("Joint Venture/Alliance SDC Deal Number" = "deal"),
    technique := i.technique]
cat("Share of alliances found in the technique files:",
    round(mean(sdc$`Joint Venture/Alliance SDC Deal Number` %in% tech$deal), 4), "\n")
stopifnot(mean(sdc$`Joint Venture/Alliance SDC Deal Number` %in% tech$deal) > 0.99)

sdc[, jv_flag := `Joint Venture Flag` == "True"]
sdc[, tech_eq := has_code(technique, equity_codes)]
sdc[, equity  := if (equity_definition == "jv_only") jv_flag else jv_flag | tech_eq]

sdc[, period := fcase(year < 2000, "before 2000", year < 2010, "2000-2009",
                      year < 2020, "2010-2019", default = "2020 onwards")]
tab_eq <- sdc[, .(alliances        = .N,
                  equity_based     = sum(equity),
                  non_equity       = sum(!equity),
                  equity_share_pct = round(100 * mean(equity), 1)), by = period][order(period)]
tab_eq <- rbind(tab_eq,
                data.table(period = "Total", alliances = nrow(sdc), equity_based = sum(sdc$equity),
                           non_equity = sum(!sdc$equity),
                           equity_share_pct = round(100 * mean(sdc$equity), 1)))
knitr::kable(tab_eq, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = paste("Equity-based and non-equity alliances by period, definition:", equity_definition))

# composition of the equity-based group (for the text of the data chapter, not for the table)
cat("Equity-based alliances:", sum(sdc$equity),
    "| of which joint venture flag:", sum(sdc$equity & sdc$jv_flag),
    "| added by technique ET/CET only:", sum(sdc$equity & !sdc$jv_flag), "\n")
```

## 2. Selection criteria

Two criteria (thesis 3.1): status *Completed/Signed* (pending alliances
cannot be expected to influence subsequent growth) and exactly two
participants (so that industry distance is unambiguous).

```{r}
#| label: filter
status <- sdc[, .N, by = Status][order(-N)][, share := round(N / sum(N), 3)]
knitr::kable(status, caption = "Alliance status in the raw extract")

n_part <- sdc[, .N, by = `Number of Participants`][order(-N)][1:5]
knitr::kable(n_part, caption = "Number of participants (top 5)")

dy <- sdc[`Number of Participants` == "2" & Status == "Completed/Signed"]
cat("Alliances in extract:", nrow(sdc), "\nAfter selection:     ", nrow(dy), "\n")
```

## 3. One row per participant

```{r}
#| label: split
fields <- c(name    = "Participant Long Name",
            cusip6  = "Participant 6-digit CUSIP",
            nation  = "Participant Nation",
            sic     = "Participant Primary SIC (Code)",
            ps      = "Participant Public Status (Code)",
            pp      = "Participant Ultimate Parent Public Status (Code)",
            pname   = "Participant Ultimate Parent Name",
            pnation = "Participant Ultimate Parent Nation",
            pcusip6 = "Participant Ultimate Parent 6-digit CUSIP",
            psic    = "Participant Ultimate Parent Primary SIC (Code)")

get_side <- function(k) {
  out <- dy[, .(deal = `Joint Venture/Alliance SDC Deal Number`, year,
                jv = equity, side = k)]   # jv = equity-based alliance (see 1b)
  for (f in names(fields)) {
    parts <- tstrsplit(dy[[fields[f]]], ";", fixed = TRUE, fill = NA_character_)
    out[, (f) := trimws(parts[[k]])]
  }
  out
}

tp <- rbind(get_side(1), get_side(2))
tp[, id := .I]
dim(tp)   # 318,970 = 159,485 alliances x 2 sides

# every row also learns the SIC code (and listing status) of the OTHER partner
other <- tp[, .(deal, side = 3L - side, partner_sic = sic, partner_ps = ps,
                partner_pp = pp, partner_nation = nation)]
tp <- other[tp, on = .(deal, side)]

# sanity check: first alliance seen from both sides
knitr::kable(tp[deal == tp$deal[1], .(side, name, sic, partner_sic)])
```

## 4. Alliance duration (justification of the three-year window, thesis 3.3.2)

SDC rarely reports a termination date, so the duration of an alliance cannot
be measured directly. The window length is therefore based on the literature
(three years); the numbers below show that this is plausible for the data.

```{r}
#| label: duration
sdc[, date_term := excel_date(`Date Terminated`)]
cat("Share of alliances with a termination date:",
    round(mean(!is.na(sdc$date_term)), 3), "\n")

dur <- sdc[!is.na(date_term), .(years = as.numeric(date_term - date) / 365.25)]
summary(dur$years)
quantile(dur$years, 0.75)
```

## 5. Save

```{r}
#| label: save
saveRDS(tp, file.path(path, "sdc_participants.rds"))
saveRDS(list(all_alliances = nrow(sdc), kept_alliances = nrow(dy),
             participants  = nrow(tp),
             equity_definition = equity_definition,
             equity_alliances  = sum(dy$equity), jv_flag_alliances = sum(dy$jv_flag)),
        file.path(path, "sdc_counts.rds"))
```
